description: This file defines the interface for a logging framework, including types, function declarations for initializing, configuring, and logging, as well as managing sinks, channels, and loggers.

methods.name: ocudulog_init
methods.description: Initializes the logging framework; must be called before generating log entries.

methods.name: ocudulog_set_default_sink
methods.description: Sets the default sink used by new log channels and loggers.

methods.name: ocudulog_get_default_sink
methods.description: Returns the current default sink instance.

methods.name: ocudulog_fetch_log_channel
methods.description: Retrieves a log channel by id, creating it with default configuration.

methods.name: ocudulog_find_log_channel
methods.description: Finds a log channel by id in the repository.

methods.name: ocudulog_set_log_channel_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific log channel.

methods.name: ocudulog_is_log_channel_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a log channel is enabled.

methods.name: ocudulog_get_log_channel_id
methods.description: Returns the id string of a log channel.

methods.name: ocudulog_log
methods.description: Logs a message to a specified log channel with printf-style formatting.

methods.name: ocudulog_fetch_default_logger
methods.description: Retrieves a default logger by id.

methods.name: ocudulog_find_default_logger
methods.description: Finds a logger by id in the repository.

methods.name: ocudulog_debug
methods.description: Logs a debug message using a logger.

methods.name: ocudulog_info
methods.description: Logs an info message using a logger.

methods.name: ocudulog_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message using a logger.

methods.name: ocudulog_error
methods.description: Logs an error message using a logger.

methods.name: ocudulog_get_logger_id
methods.description: Returns the id string of a logger.

methods.name: ocudulog_set_logger_level
methods.description: Sets the logging level for a logger.

methods.name: ocudulog_find_sink
methods.description: Finds a sink by id.

methods.name: ocudulog_fetch_stdout_sink
methods.description: Returns a sink that writes to stdout.

methods.name: ocudulog_fetch_stderr_sink
methods.description: Returns a sink that writes to stderr.

methods.name: ocudulog_fetch_file_sink
methods.description: Returns a sink that writes into a file at a specified path.
